provenance.note: Tests repo_scope filtering in L4 skill matching.

task_description: L4 procedural memory scoping: a skill planted with repo_scope must be chosen over an off-topic skill for its own repository and must not be chosen for another repository.
test_steps: Plant an on-topic skill and an off-topic skill, both scoped to repo A
POST /skills/match with a deploy query and repo_path=repo A
Verify the on-topic scoped skill ranks above the off-topic plant
POST /skills/match with the same query and repo_path=repo B
Verify the repo-A skill is not returned at all
